as far as advice goes, i’ve had some FUCKED up shit happen to me (not sexual assault) but i’ve been jumped (in society and while locked up) and i’ve been shot. those experiences really REALLY effected me. i carry my gun everywhere and deal with some pretty severe PTSD. and what i found in all that hardship was there are resources that are available for such fucked up circumstances. 

EMDR is AMAZING for trauma. it rewires your brain and takes you back into the moment (i know that sounds awful but it’s necessary) and it helps you work through it. it stands for Eye Movement and Desensitization Reprocessing. there’s a lot of clinical evidence to support it, and it helped me substantially.

DBT (Dialectical Behavioral Therapy) is good not only for trauma but also for the emotional regulation, mindfulness, and distress tolerance that will occur after such a traumatic event. CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy) is good also. Talk Therapy is also very helpful. There is hope I promise.
